hypothesis: After cold restoration and an unlabeled causal-world return, choosing paid physical actions that discriminate retained causal-rule memories improves correct unseen-pair and early post-return forecasts versus passive, random and independently coded conventional active controls, without more confident errors.
world: 4-bit state, 4 causal actions. A,B,C are distinct 40-rule/physical-action effects generated from Python Random(seed*131 + phase*719 + action*47), resolving collisions by incrementation. A/B/C phases each 20 physical steps. Fourth 20-step phase returns A (ABCA), B (ABCB), remains stationary A (STABLE), or presents out-of-grammar D effect= int(state==15) xor ((seed+action)&1) (ABCD_OOD). Hidden regimes and seed stay evaluator-only; no environment oracle accessible to learners.
action_budget: 80 paid physical steps/arm/world. At indices [6,14,22,30,38,46,54,62,70,78] paid exogenous flips of bit (seed//7+step//8)%4, not mechanism observations. All other 70 steps are actual causal actions. Before index 60 all policies use fixed action (seed+step)%4? NO: fairness requires learner-independent action (step%4), so use step%4 for all arms 0..59. During steps 60..79 policies autonomously choose actions from only current physical state and learned masks; passive uses step%4, random uses private fixed RNG seed 777 plus step (not world seed).
paired_design: Before 60, each arm receives identical physical trajectory, physical observations and learner-specific state updates. At physical step 60 each arm gets an integrity-checked cold checkpoint, is restored, and then acts independently in a cloned world with same regime rules/starting state. From 60 onward actions may diverge; compare matched budget 80/arm/world, not identical action trajectories. No extra free active probes or ground-truth state resets. Each 32-world arm costs 2560 paid steps; seven arms total 17920 paid steps (32*7*80), with 70 causal observations per arm/world.
arms: native_active: frozen SL05 ColdThreeBank(gate=True, evict=False) with paid bank-disagreement intervention after cold restore
native_passive: identical frozen ColdThreeBank + action step%4 after restore
native_random: identical frozen ColdThreeBank + deterministic nonadaptive action RNG after restore
native_active_no_gate: frozen ColdThreeBank(gate=False) + same paid active intervention (confidence-gate ablation)
conventional_active: independent SL05 ConventionalHMM3(replay=True) plus separately coded posterior-weighted causal discrimination policy
conventional_passive: identical SL05 ConventionalHMM3(replay=True) with step%4 physical actions
two_bank_active: inherited frozen SL05 two-bank SL04 selective learner plus paid disagreement policy
native_policy: At each nonflip step>=60, for each of four actions calculate predictions of up to three retained memory banks using ONLY current physical state, no world knowledge. Priority1 number of disagreeing unanimous per-bank predictions (=n0*n1), priority2 sum of within-bank rule-posterior disagreement uncertainty (Gini as integer pair count z*o), tie lowest action index. If all priority1=0, priority2 encourages informative training. Fixed bounded 4*3*40 rule evaluations per decision. Predict pre-update action consequence once and update model only from actual physical consequence.
conventional_policy: Independently coded 3-bank Bayesian-style HMM with its own masks, posteriors and same action budget. For each action, compute posterior-weighted Bernoulli effect uncertainty from its currently retained bank rule masks, score weighted predictive variance and bank-to-bank variance; select highest, ties lowest action index. It has 3 continuous weights, so logical capacity and CPU NOT exactly matched; report both and do not claim native superiority without true matched-cost control.
holdout: No learner receives true phase, transition rule, seed, full audit labels or simulator calls. At exact steps 60,64,72,80, evaluator-only exhaustive all 16 states x4 causal actions (64 pairs); record correct/wrong/abstain plus unseen physically unobserved state/action pairs separately per arm. Before/after cold predictions and snapshots must match for all 64 pairs; on cold restore active branch continues using restored object.

primary.classification: DEV_SIGNAL_NOT_SCIENCE only if ALL above; MIXED_DEV if ABCA+ABCB gains but failures on safety/cost controls, otherwise NEGATIVE_DEV. INVALID on leakage, uncharged probes, altered seeds, priors, actions or thresholds. No post-result threshold tuning.

negative_controls: No-gate ablation tests selective abstention; passive and random isolate intervention; conventional-active is independent strong competing selector; static 2-bank tests memory capacity. Entire cost, snapshot bytes, physical action counts and cross-platform deterministic receipts must be reported separately. Since world trajectories diverge after step 60, common-information content is not identical even though paid budgets match; disclose.
code_limits: Python 3.12 standard library, no gradient, tokens, external paid API or special hardware. Experiments branch-only source, prereg and evidence; no main/native model/accepted-ref/owner-loop/controller or parallel research mutations. Repo evidence only, not ChatGPT storage.
